description:
The Greedy Hamster's Stash: Giving Feels Better! — Harry the hamster hid 500 sunflower seeds in his secret burrow! Why did having all the seeds make him feel so empty inside?
Kids science answer for "generosity moral story for children" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Stuffing all the seeds into your own cheeks makes your mouth hurt, but baking seed muffins for your forest friends warms your heart.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
